accepted_claim_zh: 端到端测试确认长请求加速，短请求性能非劣
short_definition: Vanilla median observed initial reasoning <=750, reused unchanged for DTB; mean repeats within business question, then question equal weight
limitations: Two historical runs; request bootstrap does not include run-level drift
Fixed initial business inputs do not imply all generated downstream prompts are identical
Native same-input control is also faster, so all acceleration cannot be attributed solely to DTB
No independent task/answer quality labels; two empty-tool-arguments anomalies remain
previous_analysis_snapshot: comparison.json retains the earlier stricter causal/noninferiority flags; its numeric results are unchanged
